Stalin claims victory in Tamil Nadu bypoll, criticizes opponents

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has described the results of a recent byelection as an "interim victory for betrayal" and the "downfall of fake images politics." He specifically targeted Vijay, indicating a political criticism directed at him or his associated image. The byelection outcome is being framed by Stalin as a significant political statement.
